description: This file defines a class DemoRecipes which contains static demo data for recipes used within the app, including a list of Recipe objects with properties such as id, title, imageUrl, description, ingredients, directions, cuisine, diets, and cookingTimeMinutes. It also provides methods to extract unique cuisines and diet tags from the demo data.

classes.name: DemoRecipes
classes.description: A utility class providing static demo recipe data for the application.

methods.name: cuisines
methods.description: Returns a sorted list of unique cuisine types present in the demo recipes.

methods.name: diets
methods.description: Returns a sorted list of unique diet tags present in the demo recipes.
